description: BenQ currently offers a wide variety of monitors that cater to the general consumer, the professional and the gamer. While rising memory prices have affected sales, it’s not in the places one would expect and there’s a strange connection between them, explains Rajeev Singh, MD, BenQ India and South Asia.
title: BenQ’s Monitor Sales Have Strange Connection With Rising Memory Prices: Rajeev Singh, MD, BenQ India

description: WhatsApp is reportedly developing a new Android home screen widget that could allow users to record and send voice messages without opening the app. Spotted in WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.24.2, the feature is still under development and unavailable to testers. Users may be able to record a voice note from the home screen, send it to multiple recipients, and even use it as a status update. The development follows WhatsApp's ongoing work on another home screen widget for status updates.
title: WhatsApp Working on Voice Note Widget for Quick Access via Android Home Screen

description: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Game Pass wave 2 lineup for June. Starting this week, the service will add EA Sports FC 26, Call of Duty: Vanguard, RV There Yet?, Abyssus, and more. Game Pass is also getting a day one title, Junkster.
title: EA Sports FC 26, Call of Duty: Vanguard and More Coming to Xbox Game Pass This Month

description: New research suggests that supermassive black holes may host the formation of giant planets within their surrounding dusty disks.
title: Scientists Discover Giant Planet Formation Around Supermassive Black Holes

description: The iPhone 18 series is just a few months away, and the rumour mill has been churning out information about Apple’s next-generation iPhone models at a pretty rapid pace. According to a recent claim, the iPhone 18 Pro Max may not be dramatically different from the current model in terms of dimensions. A comparison recently shared by a tipster on social media shows that a dummy unit of the purported handset fits in an iPhone 17 Pro Max case. However, it could feature a noticeably thicker camera module.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Dummies Hint at Case Compatibility With iPhone 17 Pro Max Despite Thicker Camera Bump

description: OnePlus 15R is now available in India in a third RAM and storage variant. The new RAM option is listed on the company website with a higher price tag. However, other specifications, features, and colour options of the smartphone remain unchanged. The handset sports a 6.83-inch Full-HD+ AMOLED display with up to 165Hz refresh rate, 450 ppi pixel density, a 19.8:9 aspect ratio, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. It is powered by Qualcomm's 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 3.8GHz.
title: OnePlus 15R Now Available in New 16GB RAM Variant in India With Higher Price Tag: Specifications, Features

description: Binance has defended its EU licensing efforts, stating that Greece’s capital markets regulator found its MiCA application compliant pending ESMA approval. The response follows reports suggesting the exchange could face difficulties securing authorisation in the region.
title: Binance Defends EU Licence Compliance Following Reports of Possible Rejection

description: Google has announced that Android Parental Controls will expand to all devices running Android 17. The update brings parental supervision tools and Google Family Link features into a dedicated section of Android Settings. Parents can set screen time limits, create downtime schedules, restrict app downloads, and manage app access. Google is also increasing its US digital wellbeing fund to more than $50 million (roughly Rs. 470 crore). The announcement follows Apple's recent unveiling of new parental control features for iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27.
title: Google Extends Android's Parental Controls Beyond Pixel Phones With Android 17

description: Honor X80 Pro Max will launch in China later this month. Latest teasers confirm that the display of the phone will offer 10,000 nits peak brightness. 10,000 nits. The display will offer 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It is confirmed to have 1.3mm bezels. The Honor X80 Pro Max will have an 11,000mAh battery. It is currently available for pre-reservations in China.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Teased With 10,000 Nits Display Ahead of June 22 Launch

description: The stable version of the Android 17 update is now rolling out to eligible Google Pixel devices, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on Tuesday. With the release of Android 17, the Mountain View-based tech giant has kept the list of eligible Google Pixel devices almost unchanged from last year’s Android 16 update, while adding support for the latest Google Pixel 10, Google Pixel 10 Pro, Google Pixel 10 Pro XL, and Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold, which were launched in India in August last year. This means that even if you have a Google Pixel 6 series handset, you can download the latest Android 17 update on your device.
title: Google's Android 17 Update Is Compatible With These Pixel Devices: See Complete List

description: Vivo Y500 4G is confirmed to launch soon in Nepal. The latest teasers shared by Vivo on Instagram confirm that the handset will have a 1.5K Infinity AMOLED display and an 8,100mAh battery. While the company has yet to reveal a launch date, the promotional posts suggest that it may not be far off. The 5G variant of Vivo Y500 was launched in China in September last year with a MediaTek Dimensity 7300 SoC under the hood.
title: Vivo Y500 4G Global Launch Teased; Confirmed to Debut With 8,100mAh Battery

description: Kolahalamedu is a Malayalam Survival Thriller film that has finally made its way to the digital screens. The film revolves around a terrifying hunt for the predator, which eats humans in the village.
title: Kolahalamedu Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Malayalam Survival Thriller Film Online

description: Microsoft has made Copilot Cowork generally available to Microsoft 365 Copilot customers worldwide after a three-month preview period. The AI-powered service is designed to automate complex tasks across multiple tools and business applications. The rollout introduces usage-based pricing, new spending controls, additional security features, browser-based actions through Edge, and expanded third-party integrations. Copilot Cowork currently supports Anthropic's Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6 models, while GPT 5.5 remains available through Frontier. Microsoft also plans to launch a new model called Cowork 1.
title: Microsoft's Copilot Cowork Feature Rolls Out Globally for Microsoft 365 Customers

description: Bitcoin traded near $65,700 on Wednesday as investors remained cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy announcement. Analysts said expectations around future rate cuts, mixed ETF flows, and limited sell-side supply are shaping market sentiment, while traders monitor the $68,000 resistance level for signs of a stronger breakout
title: Cryptocurrency Prices Stabilise as US Fed Rate Cut Outlook Guides Investor Sentiment

description: Apple is expected to launch all the iPhone 18 series models with 12GB of RAM, including the standard iPhone 18, according to a report. This is said to allow Apple’s most advanced AI foundational models to run on the rumoured handset, consequently widening the Siri AI adoption and increasing the demand for the upcoming iPhone 18 series handsets. While most AI features will be available on iPhone 15 Pro and later models, the company’s most advanced AI features will not be available on handsets that feature RAM lower than 12GB. Hence, only the iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, and iPhone Air will be able to run the new powerful AI models. Meanwhile, the standard iPhone 17 model ships with 8GB of RAM.
title: iPhone 18 to Launch With More RAM to Enable Support for More Advanced Siri AI Features: Report

description: Google on Wednesday released the latest Pixel drop for June 2026. The update brings several new features to Pixel devices, including some that were previously believed to arrive with Android 17 later this year. The company has added Screen Reactions, allowing users to interact with on-screen content using AI-powered contextual responses. There are also Gemini Omni-powered video editing capabilities and Bubbles, which lets users turn select apps into floating bubbles.
title: Google Pixel Drop for June Brings Android 17’s Real-Time Screen Reactions, Bubbles Features to Pixel Phones

description: Xiaomi is reportedly planning a staggered release for the Xiaomi 18 series. Instead of releasing the standard and Pro models together, the company could launch the premium Xiaomi 18 Pro first. The standard Xiaomi 18 is said to arrive shortly thereafter. They are said to come with two 200-megapixel sensors. They could run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is likely to go official in September.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Could Launch Before Standard Xiaomi 18 Model, Tipster Claims

description: Silo is a psychological Sci-Fi mystery drama series that is set to arrive with its third season, only on Apple TV+. It stars Rebecca Ferguson in the lead role.
title: Silo Season 3 OTT Release Date Revealed: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide has appeared on Singapore's IMDA certification database ahead of its expected debut next month. The listing, which carries model number SM-F971B, confirms support for 5G, NFC, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Ultra Wideband connectivity. Earlier BIS listings in India also referenced the device. Leaks suggest the foldable could feature a 7.6-inch inner display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, dual 50-megapixel rear cameras, and a 4,800mAh battery. Samsung may unveil the handset at Galaxy Unpacked on July 22.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide Appears on IMDA Database, New Wide Foldable Phone Could Arrive Soon

description: Google has started rolling out Wear OS 7 to eligible Pixel Watch models, bringing new features focused on real-time information, device connectivity, and battery efficiency. The update adds Live Updates, a media output switcher, and support for interactions with upcoming smart glasses. Google also confirmed that select Wear OS 7 devices will receive Gemini Intelligence features later this year, including Create My Widget and app automation tools. The company said users upgrading from Wear OS 6 can expect up to 10 percent longer battery life.
title: Google's Wear OS 7 Update Rolls Out to Pixel Watch With Live Updates, Better Battery Life

description: Microsoft had reportedly already planned to shut down or spin off Ninja Theory when the studio announced its next game, Senua, at Xbox Games Showcase in June. The company reportedly believed that announcing a new game would help the studio attract new investment and split from Xbox.
title: Micosoft Planned to Shut Ninja Theory Before Senua Was Announced at Xbox Games Showcase: Report

description: OnePlus N6 will be launched in India with an 8,000mAh battery, the smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The company claims it to be the largest battery in the Rs. 25,000 segment. On top of this, the company claims that the phone will provide three days of battery life and a seven-year battery health. However, other details, including the chipset, camera configuration, and features, remain under wraps. The handset is set to debut in the country on June 30 at 12 pm IST. It will go on sale in the country via Amazon.
title: OnePlus N6 Will Launch in India With the Same Battery as the Higher-End OnePlus Nord CE 6

description: Android 17 is now rolling out to eligible Google Pixel devices, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced on Tuesday. Users with Google Pixel 6 and new smartphones, Google Pixel Fold, and Google Pixel Tablet can now install the stable version of the latest Android 17 update. The update brings various new features to offer an improved multitasking and gaming experience. For reference, Android 17 introduces Bubbles, which lets users turn any app into a floating window, allowing them to switch between apps easily. The update also brings various security and privacy features.
title: Android 17 Starts Rolling Out to Compatible Google Pixel Devices With Bubbles, Screen Reactions and New AI Features

description: Roblox on Wednesday announced the rollout of Roblox Kids and Roblox Select accounts globally. As per the company, the new age-based experiences are designed for users under the age of 16. Such accounts include features like age checks, content ratings, moderation systems, and parental controls, combining them into a unified safety framework. The new account types are now available in India following an initial rollout in select markets, including Australia, Indonesia, the Netherlands, and New Zealand.
title: Roblox Kids, Roblox Select Accounts With Enhanced Safety Tools, Age-Based Protections Rolled Out in India

description: Pritam and Pedro is an upcoming web series which has been created and produced by Rajkumar Hirani and features a stellar starcast. Streaming soon.
title: Pritam and Pedro OTT Release: Know When and Where to Watch Rajkumar Hirani's New Series Online?

description: Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 reportedly spotted on China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT). It is said to be the first Xiaomi smartphone to launch with HyperOS 4 out of the box. It is tipped to launch ahead of the Xiaomi 18 series, which is expected to go official in September. The foldable could offer 5G connectivity and is claimed to run HyperOS 4. It is said to feature Xiaomi's in-house Xring O3 chip.
title: Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 Reportedly Passes Regulatory Hurdles, Might Be First Phone to Run HyperOS 4

description: Reliance Jio, Bharti Airtel, and Vodafone Idea have opposed TRAI's proposal to expand the availability of cheaper standalone voice and SMS plans. The regulator wants operators to offer voice-and-SMS-only vouchers across all validity periods and price them lower than bundled plans. Telecom companies argue the proposal is impractical and could affect existing tariff structures, while consumer groups say millions of feature phone users pay for data they do not use. TRAI will review stakeholder submissions before taking a final decision.
title: Jio, Airtel, Vi Reportedly Raise Concerns Over TRAI's Proposal for Voice-Only Plans

description: The market value of tokenised assets has surpassed $43 billion as traditional financial products continue moving onto blockchain networks. Data from Token Terminal shows strong growth in tokenised funds, commodities, and stocks despite broader weakness in crypto markets.
title: Tokenised Assets Reach $43 Billion Market Value on Rising Blockchain Adoption

description: Kenatha Kanom is now streaming on JioHotstar, featuring Yogesh Babu in a satirical tale of water scarcity and an unexpected dinosaur fossil discovery.
title: Kenatha Kanom OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Yogesh Babu’s Satirical Drama Online?

description: Samsung announced a new artificial intelligence (AI)-powered pet care solution at VivaTech 2026 in Paris on Wednesday. The feature is being developed in collaboration with startup Lifet. Part of Samsung's broader connected healthcare vision, it would allow Galaxy smartphone users to monitor health issues in their pets using just a photograph. It is claimed to be capable of analysing photos for signs of potential conditions like cataracts, dental diseases, and patellar luxation.
title: Samsung Unveils AI-Powered Pet Health Monitoring Tool for Galaxy Smartphones at VivaTech 2026

description: Milagrow iMap G5 Eco has been launched in India. It combines vacuuming and mopping functions and features a Japanese brushless motor with up to 14,000Pa of suction power. The Milagrow iMap G5 Eco features a 5,200mAh battery that is advertised to deliver 270 minutes of runtime in a single charge. The robot has 32 intelligent sensors. It supports voice commands through Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant,
title: Milagrow iMap G5 Eco Robotic Vacuum Cleaner Launched in India With Up to 14,000Pa Suction: Price, Features

description: Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n will be launched as the company's first laptop powered by the recently announced Nvidia RTX Spark chipset, according to a report. The rumoured laptop is said to be launched in Fall 2026 in at least a Thunder Gray colourway. It reportedly shares its metal chassis with the Lenovo Yoga Pro 9i (2026), which was showcased globally earlier this year during the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) 2026. The Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n will reportedly feature up to 128GB of RAM and sport a 15-inch display with Lenovo PureSight Pro and Dolby Vision. The Yoga Pro 9n might ship with Windows 11 and feature a backlit keyboard, with a dedicated Copilot key. The touchpad will also ship with stylus support.
title: Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n Design Renders, Key Specifications Leaked; Nvidia RTX Spark-Powered Laptop Could Launch Soon

description: Sony Semiconductor Solutions announced the LYT-L910 CMOS image sensor for smartphones on Wednesday. It is positioned as one of the first offerings in the brand’s Lytia lineup to feature the LOFIC (Lateral Overflow Integration Capacitor) technology. Sony claims the sensor can deliver up to 100dB dynamic range while maintaining low power consumption. It is designed to deliver up to 4K 60fps video recording, along with improved HDR imaging, night photography, and video recording capabilities on smartphones.
title: Sony Unveils Lytia L910 CMOS Image Sensor With LOFIC Structure, 4K 60fps Video Support

description: Apple is said to be planning to expand its product lineup with several ambitious devices next year. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant will commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone in 2027, and it could mark it by launching a special iPhone. Alongside, AirPods with built-in cameras and Apple’s second-generation foldable iPhone could also see the light of day. The purported devices are said to be in advanced stages of development.
title: Apple's 20th Anniversary iPhone, Camera-Equipped AirPods to Reportedly Launch in 2027

description: Qualcomm announced the Snapdragon Reality Elite Platform at the Augmented World Expo (AWE) on Tuesday. It is the latest SoC designed to power mixed reality (MR), virtual reality (VR), and emerging spatial computing devices. Arriving as the successor to the Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 chip, the Snapdragon Reality Elite focuses on delivering on-device AI and improved graphics performance while maintaining power efficiency. Qualcomm said that it is capable of powering both all-in-one video see-through (VST) headsets and lightweight optical see-through (OST) smart glasses.
title: Qualcomm Announces Snapdragon Reality Elite SoC With 48 TOPS AI Compute, Support for Android XR Headsets

description: Snap launched its new Specs augmented reality (AR) smart glasses on Tuesday during the Augmented World Expo 2026. The new Specs smart glasses are currently available for pre-order via the Specs online store. The company expects to ship its new AR smart glasses this fall or between September, October, and November, in the US, the UK, and France. Specs AR glasses ship in two sizes. While the 47mm model weighs about 132g, the larger 52mm variant tips the scale at 136g. Moreover, the removable inserts also support prescription lenses. The display system of the smart glasses is powered by the tech firm’s proprietary liquid crystal on silicon technology.
title: Snap Launches Specs AR Smart Glasses With a Built-In Display, Up to 20 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: SpaceX has acquired AI coding startup Cursor in a $60 billion (roughly Rs. 5,66,500 crore) all-stock deal. The companies confirmed the acquisition on X and said they have been jointly training an AI model that will be released through Cursor and Grok Build. The deal follows a partnership announced in April that gave SpaceX the option to buy Cursor. Founded in 2022 as Anysphere, Cursor competes with Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2026.
title: SpaceX Acquires Cursor, the AI Coding Startup Competing With Claude Code and OpenAI Codex

description: Microsoft Surface Pro and Surface laptops were launched in global markets. They run on Snapdragon X2 processors paired with integrated Adreno GPU. They feature up to 64GB of RAM and are advertised to offer up to 20 hours of video playback on a single charge. The Microsoft Surface Pro has a 13-inch display, while the Microsoft Surface comes in 13.8-inch and 15-inch sizes.
title: Microsoft Surface, Surface Pro Launched With Snapdragon X2 Series Chips: Price, Specifications

description: CD Projekt Red is reportedly working on a previously unannounced The Witcher multiplayer game for PC and mobile. The game, which is said to be a free-to-play action-RPG set in The Witcher universe, stands separate from Project Sirus, the other mutiplayer Witcher game in the works at the company.
title: Unannounced The Witcher Multiplayer Game for PC and Mobile Reportedly in the Works at CD Projekt Red

description: Epson India has launched 15 new EcoTank printers in India. The new Epson printers offer printing speeds of up to 11 images per minute (ipm) for black-and-white, and up to 6ipm for colour. The Epson EcoTank L3360 and L5390 feature 1.44-inch colour LCD panels. They are said to deliver black ink yields of up to 4,700 pages and colour ink yields of up to 7,500 pages.
title: Epson Expands EcoTank Portfolio in India With 15 New Printer Models

description: The Motorola Razr Fold has a premium design and a sleek profile. The handset packs a vivid 6.8-inch AMOLED display with good viewing angles. The handset also comes with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor, which is capable of delivering flagship performance. The phone also features a triple-camera setup that delivers professional-grade results in different lighting conditions. The device also features a 5,200mAh battery and supports 90W fast charging.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Review: The Best First-Generation Foldable Ever Made?
